title: AgentShield AI - Before / After Remediation

findings.title: Dangling dependency references
findings.remediation: Ship the referenced assets alongside the agent, or make the agent degrade gracefully and announce when they are absent.

findings.title: Over-privileged tool grant versus role
findings.observation: Write-capable tools granted: edit, create, delete
findings.remediation: Remove write tools unless a concrete write use-case exists; if retained, restrict writes to a declared output directory.

findings.title: Hardcoded external endpoint(s)
findings.remediation: Make external endpoints configurable and allowlisted.

findings.title: Unversioned definition with no integrity marker
findings.observation: No 'version:' field found in the definition.
findings.remediation: Add a version field and an integrity/hash marker.

findings.title: No explicit instruction-hierarchy / untrusted-content defense
findings.observation: No instruction-hierarchy or untrusted-content isolation language found.
findings.remediation: State that system instructions take precedence and that external/tool content is untrusted data, never instructions.
